items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: one of the major influences in my life was Sam Scamacca... Sedola gave it to you. You already know it.

ctx.x: Once in a while. She threw water on me a couple of times. She actually did that a couple of times. “You’ve got to get up, you’ve got to go to school.” So then I got a pact with, again, one of the major influences in my life was Sam Scamacca, my high school.

Scamacca. S-C-A-M-A-C-C-A. Sam was cool. Sam was great. And he ended up being the principal there, retired as principal, the whole bit. But when I would go to school Sam basically said okay we’ve got History of Music first period, whatever music course second period and then you’ve got gym. Well he’d give me a note for gym and then let me sleep through my first two classes only under the guise that I would get no less than 100 on the tests. He says, “You know a lot of this. This theory stuff, you know it already.…
